Gathering governance docs on automation, scene pipelines, QA, and gameplay boundaries.

[REDACTED]

Here is a concise extraction from the governance and planning docs you pointed at (primarily `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AI_DOCS.md`, `SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md`, `AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md`, `PREMIUM_TO_AUTO_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`, and relevant bits of `AXEL_combat_implementation.md`). There is no document that names a “gameplay bot” explicitly; the closest approved automation is **headless Godot scripts**, **combat subsystem isolation**, and **`scene agent` / `qa agent` pipelines**.

---

### 1) Architecture boundaries and invariants (gameplay / automation impact)

- **Layer split — do not blur** (`AI_DOCS.md` §4): narrative/prototype lives in `AXEL/html/…` + `exports/game_data.json` + reference `GameManager.gd`; **combat** is orchestrated by `combat/scripts/combat_root.gd` under `res://combat/`. A bot or driver should not casually mix narrative runners with combat RNG/state without an explicit design reason.
- **`exports/moon_princess_files/*` is reference-only** — not authoritative runtime logic (`AI_DOCS.md` §4–5).
- **Combat invariants** (`AI_DOCS.md` §5): 5×5 grid; **line-based** row/column wins of 3+ (no flood-fill cluster wins for main resolution); **wilds only from winning lines of exactly 3**, middle cell; **multiplier tied to cascade/drop progression**, not arbitrary per-line bumps; **`combat_root.gd` stays the orchestration spine** (spin → resolve → cascade → power → checks); fixed princess/premium alias map; **terminology**: Regular Free Spins = **Trinity Run**, SUPER Free Spins = later mode — clarify if a request says only “Free Spins”.
- **Determinism / reproducibility** (`AI_DOCS.md` §8; `AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §0): systems meant to be replayable/testable should stay deterministic; combat doc says **all randomness through a single seeded `RNG`**, not raw `randi()` — any automated “bot” that perturbs grids or spins must respect that contract or it will break determinism checks.
- **Guards** (`AI_DOCS.md` §8): avoid **machine-absolute paths in shared gameplay code**; prefer **additive, scoped** changes; watch **cross-effects** on story flags, combat economy, and presentation.
- **Hard conflict gate** (`AI_DOCS.md` §10): if a bot or tool would violate canon/invariants, planning must **stop** and offer explicit options — same applies to implementation.

---

### 2) Approved places to add tooling / tests

| Area | Location / pattern |
|------|---------------------|
| **Combat headless checks (playtest gates)** | `res://combat/test/princess_check.gd`, `determinism_check.gd`, `rtp_audit.gd` (rubric: first two + scene smoke are pass/fail gates; RTP is metrics unless you define thresholds) (`AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` §Playtest-mode) |
| **Project-wide scene smoke** | `res://test/scene_smoke_check.gd` (`AI_DOCS.md` §12) |
| **Godot invocation** | From repo root, project path `AXEL/axel_project`, Windows: `tools\cmd\godot.cmd --headless …` (`AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md`) |
| **Combat subsystem isolation** | `res://combat/` self-contained; **standalone test scene** `res://combat/test/combat_test.tscn` (layout in `AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §0, §1) |
| **Headless unit-style tests (combat)** | Line detector, cascade, wild rules, princess mocks, Trinity, free spins, goals, determinism replay — **no scene tree** where appropriate (`AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §12); runners: GUT or gdunit4 mentioned there |
| **Scene builder / layout automation** | Python: `AXEL/axel_project/tools/scene_builder/*.py`; drafts/output under `tools/scene_builder/output/` per spec (`SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md`) |
| **QA analytics refresh** | `AXEL/axel_project/tools/qa/update_qa_analytics.py` + append payloads to `AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md` (`AI_DOCS.md` §11) |
| **Docs scope for “plans” work** | `AXEL/axel_project/plans/*` is in scope for AI_DOCS (`AI_DOCS.md` §2) |

---

### 3) Naming and pipeline constraints

- **Scene files — canonical invariant** (`AI_DOCS.md` §11; `SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md` §Canonical Filename Invariant): pattern **`<arc>.<index>_<Name>.tscn`** (e.g. `1.2_Corridor.tscn`) under `scenes/Arc_<N>/` (or `Endings/`, `Main_Menu/` for special prefixes); **always overwrite the canonical path**; **never** create alias `Corridor.tscn`-style names; resolution map: `tools/scene_builder/layout_planner.py` (`CANONICAL_BY_SCENE_ID` + blueprint heading parser); patch hints: `res://scenes/<arc_dir>/<canonical_file>`.
- **Scene agent default**: **draft-first**; **no direct `.tscn` rewrites** until human approval (`SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md` §Autonomy Mode).
- **Cleanup**: on “scene complete”, remove **non-pipeline** junk under `tools/scene_builder/output/`; keep `layout_drafts/*.json`, `output/*.json`, `review_notes.md` unless user wants full purge (`SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md` §Cleanup).
- **Reusable agent names** (`AI_DOCS.md` §11): **`scene agent`**, **`qa` / `qa agent`** — keep stable when wiring automation docs.
- **Changelog / pipeline registration**: substantive implemented changes → `AI_CHANGELOG.md`; new/updated reusable pipelines → also `AI_DOCS.md` + `.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` (`AI_DOCS.md` §9, §11).
- **Premium planning handoff**: use `PREMIUM_TO_AUTO_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md` for auto-model-ready plans (intent, alignment, impact map, tasks, validation, risks, blockers).

---

### 4) Risks and conflicts to avoid

- **Violating combat invariants** (line wins only, 3-line wild rule, multiplier tied to drops, princess aliases) — rubric category **`COMBAT`** and `AI_DOCS` hierarchy.
- **`ARCH` / layer mixing**: driving combat from narrative exports or treating `moon_princess_files` as source of truth.
- **Nondeterministic automation**: bypassing central RNG, unstable item hook order, or breaking **determinism_check** / replay expectations (`AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §12, watchpoints §14).
- **Scene graph drift**: writing **non-canonical** `.tscn` paths — duplicates placeholders and desyncs the project (`SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md`).
- **Reference-only exports**: building behavior from `exports/moon_princess_files/*` instead of native Godot combat (`AI_DOCS.md`).
- **Absolute paths in shared gameplay code** — breaks portability (`AI_DOCS.md` §8).
- **QA contract**: if you integrate with `qa agent`, **every run** must log to `AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md` and refresh analytics (`AI_DOCS.md` §11) — ad-hoc reports skip the persistence invariant.
- **Canon conflicts**: must resolve via hierarchy in §3 and document overrides in `AI_CHANGELOG.md`.

If “gameplay bot” means **input simulation or AI policy over the full game loop**, the written canon pushes you toward: **respecting layer boundaries**, **hooking at `combat_root.gd` / isolated `combat/test` for combat-only bots**, **using existing headless scripts as gates**, and **not inventing alternate win resolution or RNG paths** without an explicit canon decision.
